name: pushinbr/nimbus
description: Nimbus: the API-first PHP framework for the PAM runtime.

suggest.ext-curl: HTTP/2 transport of the APNs push provider and fallback HTTP client outside PAM.
suggest.ext-openssl: Signs the FCM and APNs tokens of the push notification channel.
suggest.league/flysystem: Required by Nimbus\Storage (StorageManager, Disk, local disks).
suggest.league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3: S3 disks and presigned uploads in Nimbus\Storage.
suggest.league/oauth2-client: Social login (Nimbus\Auth\OAuth\SocialLogin); add provider packages such as league/oauth2-google or league/oauth2-github.
suggest.psr/http-client: Send push and webhook notifications through any PSR-18 client (Psr18HttpClient).
suggest.psr/log: PSR-3 logging; LoggerInterface resolves to the PAM runtime structured log.
suggest.pushinbr/arcano: Required by the Arcano ORM integration (ArcanoServiceProvider, ArcanoManager).
suggest.pushinbr/pam-socket: High-level event and room APIs for Pam WebSockets.
suggest.symfony/mailer: Required by the mail notification channel (Nimbus\Notifications\Mail\MailChannel).
suggest.symfony/translation: Translations from lang/ directories (Nimbus\Translation\Translator, __() and trans()).
